blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: An agent can improve its behavior within an unresolved problem by changing how it acts and which experience it retains. We propose MMLA-RSI, a recursive self-improvement scheme with two implementations in Memory-Mediated Learning Architecture: Reasoning-Time Training (RTT) changes the policy state $Φ$, while Reasoning-Time Memory Adaptation (RTMA) changes authoritative memory $M$. Each route also makes its adaptation method an object of improvement. A current numerical updater trains the policy proposing its successor; a current memory manager chooses the records available to the process proposing its successor. An independently admitted successor takes over the same role in the next generation. We give bounded executable rule languages, shared task/proposal interfaces, and one algorithm for either route or their composition. The RTT instance changes scalar schedules in a clipped-momentum update. The RTMA instance chooses NULL or a complete-row write with possible eviction. A fixed interpreter, trusted committer, and independent evaluator bound what can change. State versions, read closures, and conditional properties describe causal execution, accepted transitions, and finite work. Existing numerical-component studies motivate the construction. In four-candidate program selection, retaining LARC feedback updates reduces expected error by 24.65 and 36.65 percentage points for two trained initializations. In chronological continuous-integration replay, feedback binding is positive while retention increases loss. Completed SQL studies improve substantially over an unadapted substrate but do not establish the required additional online benefit. These results characterize their declared components. The two recursive routes and their joint realization are specified here; their beneficial recursive chains and discovery efficiency remain to be evaluated.

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: An unsuccessful attempt supplies information that the next attempt may need. A program fails an execution check, a query violates a visible constraint, or a candidate learning rule performs poorly on a development task. The agent must decide both how this feedback changes its behavior and which parts remain available later. Memory-Mediated Learning Architecture (MMLA) makes these two learning objects explicit: policy state Φ \Phi and authoritative memory M M [ 30 ] .
blocks.zh: 一次不成功的尝试提供了下一次尝试可能需要的信息。 程序失败执行检查,查询违反可见的制约,或者候选人学习规则在开发任务上表现不佳. 代理商必须既决定这种反馈如何改变其行为,又决定哪些部分在以后仍然可用. Memory-mediated Learning Architecture(MMLA)使这两个学习对象明确:政策状态 QQ\Phi和权威记忆 M M [30].

blocks.en: Reasoning-Time Training (RTT) updates Φ \Phi while a problem remains unresolved, then uses that state in a later attempt. Reasoning-Time Memory Adaptation (RTMA) commits a non-NULL successor of M M that a later attempt reads. The distinction follows the MMLA v4 state account. Here both paths are central. Learning a useful memory is one level of adaptation; improving the method that selects and maintains that memory is another. The same distinction holds between updating a policy state and improving its updater.

blocks.en: This dependency has direct precedents. Self-referential meta learning studies systems that modify their learning behavior [ 9 ] ; STOP executes an improver on itself, and Darwin Gödel Machine uses descendant agents in further self-modification [ 25 , 27 ] . Our construction specifies the dependency through MMLA’s two state paths: bounded numerical update programs and bounded memory-management programs, their task/proposal interfaces, and independent admission before role replacement. It makes both the changed object and its later use inspectable.

blocks.en: MMLA is mixer-agnostic. Low-Rank Adaptive Residual Connections (LARC) provide the current numerical carrier in front of a reused frozen mixer [ 29 ] . The Transformer mixer and low-rank factors are implementation choices. Φ \Phi denotes a policy-state role, not a synonym for adapter parameters; another declared fast state can fill it. M M is the committed authority for retained records, not an undifferentiated name for prompts, logs, or caches. These distinctions let the same architecture support policy adaptation, memory adaptation, and their composition.

blocks.en: The method contribution is a complete recursive construction with two concrete bounded domains. The RTT domain varies feedback-dependent schedules in a clipped-momentum template. The RTMA domain varies the rule selecting NULL or a complete-row write under finite memory capacity. We specify their state, feedback, failure, read, and version semantics, then give a common algorithm and its conditional properties. Existing component studies motivate separate measurements of functional participation, task benefit, and discovery efficiency. The proposed method, an observed beneficial recursive chain, and an advantage over fixed search are distinct levels of evidence.

blocks.en: Algorithm 5.8 collects the construction into one execution order. Its parameters fix a finite run without fixing experimental hyperparameters in this report. In addition to the language bounds, they include a generation cap K ≥ 1 K\geq 1 , a proposal cap N ≥ 2 N\geq 2 per generation, a nonempty finite development task block, fresh audit blocks, the task runner, a cost weight λ ∈ [ 0 , ∞ ) \lambda\in[0,\infty) , a deterministic tie order, and finite resource reservations for every call. At most one candidate is locked and audited in each generation. Failure of admission ends this minimal run.

For a candidate c c , execute the fixed task runner with its rule or rule pair from private copies of ρ task \rho^{\rm task} and M 0 task M_{0}^{\rm task} on the development block. Return its mean final loss L ¯ ​ ( c ) ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \bar{L}(c)\in[0,1] and normalized charged cost C ¯ ​ ( c ) ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \bar{C}(c)\in[0,1] , using the fixed per-execution cost allowance as denominator. For a legal program, a runtime exception that prevents legal feedback, a rejected numerical update or malformed memory operation, or exhaustion of a task-local allowance is a terminal task failure. It ends only that task with final loss one and its actual incurred cost; ordinary action, validation, and tool-error feedback follows the continuing runner described above. Evaluation then continues with fresh state on the remaining fixed tasks; means use the entire fixed block, never only completed successes. The same rule applies within an audit block. This is the chosen saturated objective, not an order-preserving normalization of the uncapped sum. The saturated reward guides development proposal learning and selection. Admission instead tests the bound task risk R ⁡ ( η ) R(\eta) in Equation 18 together with deterministic resource checks; a better development reward alone does not admit a successor. blocks.en: The method is the adaptation-rule-to-proposal construction in Section 5 . The following properties describe its causal execution, accepted transitions, and finite resource use under the stated assumptions.
blocks.zh: 这种方法是第5节中的适应规则对建议书的构建。 以下属性描述其因果执行,被接受的过渡,以及所陈述假设下有限的资源使用.

blocks.en: Suppose each generation begins with an adaptation-rule version measurable with respect to its admitted past; each within-task transition is measurable with respect to arrived records and permitted randomness; and an audit is opened only after the candidate is locked. If callbacks are epoch-bound and cannot modify a closed task, every action in a finite sequence of generations is measurable with respect to the information available at its execution time.
blocks.zh: 假设每代人首先使用一个可根据其承认的过去加以衡量的适应规则版本;每个任务内部的过渡就到达的记录和允许的随机性而言是可以衡量的;只有在候选人被锁上之后才开始审计。 如果回调是划时代的,并且不能修改一个已关闭的任务,则每一代人中有限的序列中的每一个动作都可以根据其执行时可获得的信息来衡量.

blocks.en: Condition on the admitted state at the start of a generation. Composition of the causal proposal kernel, arrived-feedback map, and selected adaptation operation yields a causal next state. Induction covers the finite attempts in that generation. Candidate locking precedes the audit; admission is therefore a function of information available at the generation boundary. blocks.en: 7  Component Evidence and Design Motivation
blocks.zh: 7 证据和设计动机

blocks.en: The completed studies summarized here establish implementations of the numerical carrier and its update, retention, read, and restoration operations. They do not evaluate the new recursive memory-manager domain or a joint recursive chain. They also expose difficulties that a recursive updater must address. Program selection and CI reuse the LARC experiments [ 29 ] ; the SQL studies are subsequent completed evaluations. The four populations and endpoints are distinct. Appendix B retains their full results and uncertainty, and Appendix C retains all reported cost scopes. No new experiment was run for this report.
blocks.zh: 本文概述的已完成研究确定了数字载体及其更新、保留、读取和恢复操作的实施情况。 它们不评价新的递归内存管理域或联合递归链. 它们还暴露出递归更新器必须解决的困难。 程序选择和CI重用LARC实验[29];SQL研究是随后完成的评价. 四个种群和终点是不同的。 附 录 B保留了全部结果和不确定性,附录C保留了所有报告的费用范围。 本报告没有进行新的试验。

blocks.en: Table 3: Existing component evidence, not an evaluation of the proposed recursive routes. Percentage-point differences and half-Brier differences have different units; the studies are not pooled.
blocks.zh: 表3:现有组成部分证据,而不是对拟议递归路线的评价。 百分点差异和半百分点差异有不同的单位;研究没有集合。

blocks.en: The program-selection result is a development evaluation over 16 parameter groups and three paired training seeds; its final audit remained unopened. It concerns four supplied candidate programs rather than free generation. Both learned initializations benefit from feedback, although a direct same-information rule is much more accurate. Expected and greedy decisions also order the two arms differently, and the fixed stability rule selects the static arm.
blocks.zh: 方案选择的结果是对16个参数组和3个对子培训种子进行发展评价;其最后审计仍未公开。 它涉及四个提供候选方案,而不是免费生成。 虽然直接的同信息规则要准确得多,但学到的两个初始化都得益于反馈. 期望和贪婪的决定也给两只手臂下了不同的顺序,固定稳定规则选择了静态手臂.

blocks.en: CI uses a repository-local retrospective queue, with equal repository weights over one NumPy commit and 71 pandas commits. Its three-seed means are descriptive rather than population intervals. The negative retention effect and positive binding effect show that correctly associated feedback can still drive harmful learning. The later same-batch non-descent diagnostic does not uniquely identify the cause.
blocks.zh: CI使用寄存器-本地回溯队列,在1个NumPy承诺和71个熊猫承诺上拥有平等的寄存器重. 它的三种子手段是描述性的,而不是人口间隔. 负面的保留效应和正约束效应表明,正确的关联反馈仍然会推动有害的学习. 后期同批非世系诊断不独能辨出原因.

blocks.en: The SQL studies provide task-level evaluations with seeds averaged inside tasks and databases as the resampling units. In SParC, saved replay states change some proposal tokens and selected queries without changing the paired task endpoint. CoSQL’s trained task models greatly improve over the original substrate (7.295% final-query success), but their additional online increment fails the registered requirements. The copy-edit, retrieval, and search rules reach 1.824%, 5.348%, and 0.961%; selection remains the development-chosen copy-edit rule. Both SQL endpoints measure reference execution concordance on fixed databases, not universal SQL equivalence. Shared feedback-text and selection paths remain part of their declared reads.
blocks.zh: SQL研究提供任务级评价,种子平均在任务和数据库内作为再生单位. 在 SParC 中,被保存的再播放状态会改变一些提议符和选择的查询而不改变配对的任务终点. CoSQL训练有素的任务模式比最初的底板(7.295%的终仓成功率)大有改进,但其额外的在线递增未能达到注册要求. 副本编辑、检索和搜索规则达到1.824%、5.348%和0.961%;选择仍然是开发选择的复制编辑规则。 SQL两个端点都测量了固定数据库上的引用执行相接,而不是通用的SQL等同. 共享反馈文本和选择路径仍然是其申报阅读的一部分。

blocks.en: These findings motivate searching over the learning rule while retaining separate measurements of feedback binding, state use, and task benefit. They provide component foundations, rather than a test of the recursive construction’s success or failure. A numerical update that helps a task, an updater that improves task learning, and an updater that helps produce a useful successor are observations at different levels.
blocks.zh: 这些结论激励人们探索学习规则,同时保留对反馈绑定、状态使用和任务效益的单独衡量。 它们提供了组成部分基础,而不是对递归式建筑的成败进行检验。 帮助任务的数字更新,改善任务学习的更新器,以及帮助产生有用的后继器的更新器,是不同级别的观测.

blocks.en: 8  Relation to Other Self-Improvement Routes
blocks.zh: 8 与其他自我改进路线的关系

blocks.en: MMLA-RSI connects policy and memory adaptation with recursive changes to their respective methods. Its distinction from other routes is clearest along three axes: what changes, when feedback becomes a learning signal, and how the changed object participates in the next improvement. These axes overlap; they do not partition all systems into mutually exclusive families.
blocks.zh: MMLA-RSI将政策和内存适应与各自方法的递归变化相连接. 它与其他路线的区别最明显地沿着三个轴线:什么变化,当反馈成为学习信号时,以及被改变的对象如何参与接下来的改进. 这些轴线重叠;它们没有将所有系统分割成相互排斥的家庭。

blocks.en: RRSI regularizes the evolution of an agent harness: prompts, control flow, tools, memory, and context management around a frozen backbone [ 20 ] . The current harness produces traces and feedback, proposal uses the evolution history with a constrained edit budget, and screening and cost-aware selection determine the next incumbent. The inspected algorithms keep the outer proposal and selection rules prescribed. This is an agent-system route to RSI. MMLA-RSI specifies two narrower mutable domains and their proposal-state pathways: the current numerical updater changes proposal Φ \Phi , and the current memory manager changes proposal M M . The RTMA route overlaps memory and context-management search; its defining construction is the explicit reuse of the candidate management rule in managing the evidence that generates its successor.
blocks.zh: RRSI规范了一种物剂用杠杆的演化:在被冷冻的骨干周围的提示,控制流,工具,内存和上下文管理[20]. 目前的控制装置产生痕迹和反馈,提案使用编辑预算受限的演化历史,筛选和成本意识选择决定下一个任职者。 被检查的算法保持了外部建议和选择规则的规定. 这是通往RSI的代理系统路线. MMLA-RSI指定了两个更窄的可变域及其建议状态路径: 当前的数字更新器更改提议 QQ\Phi, 当前内存管理器更改提议 M M. RTMA路由与内存和上下文管理搜索重叠;其定义构建是明确再用候选管理规则来管理产生其后继者的证据.

blocks.en: MemEvolve jointly evolves experiential knowledge and the memory architecture through programmatic encoding, storage, retrieval, and management modules [ 26 ] . Its outer process selects architectures using performance, cost, and latency, diagnoses their execution trajectories, and redesigns permitted modules. It is a direct precedent for improving the memory mechanism itself. The RTMA instance here fixes the representation and reader while varying a bounded retention-and-replacement rule. Equation 17 places that rule in a particular proposal interface: the current manager controls which arrived evaluation records the successor generator can read, and an admitted successor takes over that proposal-memory role in the next generation. The comparison concerns this parent-to-proposal dependency and the mutable domain.
blocks.zh: MemEvolve通过程序编码,存储,检索,以及管理模块[26],共同演化体验知识和内存架构. 其外接流程选择使用性能,成本和耐久性的架构,诊断其执行轨迹,并重新设计允许的模块. 这是改进记忆机制本身的直接先例。 这里的RTMA案例规定了表述和阅读者,同时修改了限制保留和替换的规则。 方程式17将这个规则放在特定的建议书界面中:到达评价的当前管理器控制记录了后继生成器能够读取,被承认的后继者在下一代中接管了建议书-回忆角色. 比较涉及这种父母对提案的依赖和可变领域。

blocks.en: On-policy distillation (OPD) supervises a student’s own rollout prefixes with teacher distributions. Agarwal et al. develop this approach through Generalized Knowledge Distillation [ 1 ] ; the Thinking Machines account provides a later practical treatment [ 11 ] . It describes a sampling and supervision relation; it does not by itself specify updates inside an unresolved answer or changes to the optimizer. In On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), a teacher from the same model family receives privileged context; the reported experiments keep that teacher fixed at the initial policy [ 28 ] . The more recent DCE+SRCL framework reuses the updated checkpoint for both student and privileged teacher in the next round [ 21 ] . This is a real recursive dependence: learned ability changes subsequent supervision. Its specified numerical optimization rule remains fixed. MMLA-RSI’s RTT branch changes that numerical rule and carries it into successor generation; its RTMA branch changes evidence retention through a memory-management rule. An OPD objective could be used inside an RTT system if its supervision were legally available at the required time.
blocks.zh: 政策蒸馏(OPD)监督学生自己的推出前缀并配有教师分布. 阿加瓦尔等. 通过通用知识分解[1]来发展这一方法;思考机账户提供了后来的实用处理[11]. 它描述了抽样和监督关系;它本身并不在未解决的答案或对优化器的修改中具体说明更新。 在 " On-Political Self-Distriction " (OPSD)中,来自同一模范家庭的一位教师得到了特殊的背景;所报告的实验使这位教师在最初的政策中固定下来 [28] 。 更近期的DCE+SRCL框架在下一轮对学生和特权教师重新使用更新的检查站[21]. 这是一个真正的递归依赖:所学的能力改变了后续的监督. 其指定的数值优化规则仍然固定. MMLA-RSI的RTT分支会改变这个数值规则并带入后继生成;它的RTMA分支会通过内存管理规则来改变证据保留. 如果在规定的时间内在法律上可以进行监督,可在RTT系统内使用OPD目标。

blocks.en: The temporal distinction from TTT also needs care. Recent aTTT updates an episode-specific LoRA from trajectory text during a live episode, then uses the adapted state in later turns [ 18 ] . Its repetition-aware token weighting limits reinforcement of repeated text. It therefore directly overlaps RTT’s within-episode numerical update timing. The separate Agentic-TTT work learns a policy for choosing adaptation tools and reusing skills across queries [ 10 ] . MMLA’s RTT account contributes an explicit same-problem state lifetime, read closure, and functional feedback witness; the MMLA-RSI RTT extension additionally uses a changed updater in generating its successor. Whether another implementation satisfies these obligations depends on its actual process, not its acronym.
blocks.zh: 与TTT的时间区分也需要注意。 最近ATT从现场剧集的轨迹文本中更新了针对一集的LORA,然后在后回转 [18] 使用被修改的状态. 它的重复- 知觉符号加权限制了重复文本的强化. 因此,它直接重复了RTT系统内的数字更新时间。 单独的Agentic-TTT工作学习了选择适应工具和跨查询重用技能的政策[10]. MMLA的RTT账户提供一个明确的相同问题状态寿命,读取关闭,以及功能反馈证人;MMLA-RSIRTT扩展在生成其后继器时额外使用被更改的更新器. 另一项执行是否满足了这些义务取决于其实际过程,而不是其缩略语。

blocks.en: Table 4: Different realizations of self-improvement. The table identifies demonstrated dependencies in the cited methods and the specified dependency of the proposed MMLA-RSI system. It is not a performance ranking.
blocks.zh: 表4:自我改进的不同实现. 该表指明了所引用方法的明显依赖性以及提议的MMLA-RSI系统的具体依赖性。 这不是业绩排名。

blocks.en: Self-Refine and Reflexion use feedback to revise outputs or maintain textual reflections [ 12 , 15 ] . Such information can improve later attempts without a numerical update. They provide relevant same-information context and memory controls. Retaining a reflection under a fixed manager and recursively changing that manager are distinct operations; both may be useful. Test-time training learns from test inputs [ 17 ] , while TTT layers treat a learnable hidden state as a sequence-model component [ 16 ] . Discover uses reinforcement learning at test time to search for solutions to open problems [ 24 ] . These works show why learning time, mutable object, and feedback source should be compared separately.
blocks.zh: 自我参考和反射利用反馈来修改产出或保持文字反射[12,15]. 此类信息可在没有数字更新的情况下改进以后的尝试。 它们提供了相关的相同信息背景和内存控制. 保留固定管理者下的反射并反复地改变管理者是不同的业务;两者都可能有用。 测试时间训练从测试输入中学习[17],而TTT层则将可学习的隐藏状态作为序列-模型组件[16]. 发现在测试时使用强化学习来寻找打开问题的解决方案 [24]. 这些作品说明了为什么学习时间,可变对象,以及反馈源应该分别比较.

blocks.en: MAML and its first-order approximation learn an initialization from which task adaptation can proceed [ 6 , 13 ] . Learned optimizers instead learn an update rule [ 2 ] . Both are relevant ingredients. Kirsch and Schmidhuber study self-referential meta learning through shared neural functionality, with fitness-monotonic execution allocating computation according to observed performance [ 9 ] . That work directly addresses learning mechanisms that participate in changing themselves. MMLA-RSI specifies bounded symbolic rules, policy or memory adaptation of the proposal process under those rules, and independent admission before version replacement.
blocks.zh: MAML及其一阶近似学从中可以开始任务适应[6,13]. 学习优化者 学习更新规则 [2]。 两者都是相关的要素。 Kirsch和Schmidhuber通过共享神经功能研究自我特长元学习,健身-运动执行根据所观察到的性能分配计算[9]. 这项工作直接涉及参与自我转变的学习机制。 MMLA-RSI具体规定了在这些规则下对建议书过程的限定符号规则、政策或内存的调整,以及版本替换前的独立认可。

blocks.en: Chen et al. formulate optimization-algorithm discovery as program search and discover Lion [ 4 ] . Representing and searching update programs is therefore an established approach. In the RTT branch, the current update program additionally trains the proposal policy producing its successor. Its bounded scalar-schedule language gives one concrete domain; the RTMA language gives a separate memory-management domain with the same parent-participation requirement.
blocks.zh: Chen等将优化-算法发现作为程序搜索并发现狮子 [4]. 因此,代表并搜索更新程序是一种既定办法。 在RTT分支中,目前的更新程序还额外训练了产生其后继者的建议书政策. 其有边框的scalar-chedule语言给出了一个混凝土域;RTMA语言给出了一个单独的内存-管理域,具有相同的父参与要求.

blocks.en: STOP is a direct precedent for procedure recursion: its update has the form I t = I t − 1 ​ ( u ^ , I t − 1 , L ) I_{t}=I_{t-1}(\hat{u},I_{t-1},L) , so the current improver produces its successor [ 25 ] . The authors’ qualification that their frozen language model is not full RSI uses a different boundary from improvement-process recursion. Darwin Gödel Machine retains self-modifying agents in an archive, allowing a descendant to become a parent of a later modification [ 27 ] . Its frozen foundation model and fixed archive management do not erase that recursive dependence. Promptbreeder changes mutation prompts and applies them to task-prompt mutation [ 5 ] ; the inspected method uses an explicit higher-level prompt for mutation-prompt evolution, so its levels should not be collapsed into unrestricted recursion.
blocks.zh: Stop是程序再现的直接先例:其更新形式为 I t = I t − 1 (u ^, I t − 1, L ) I_{t → I_{t 1 (\hat{u}, I_{t-1}, L ),因此目前的改进者产生其后继者 [25]. 作者认为他们的冷冻语言模型不是完整的RSI使用与改进过程递归不同的边界。 达尔文·格德尔机器(Darwin Gödel Machine)在档案中保留了自我修改的代理,允许后人成为后人修改的家长[27]. 它被冻结的基础模型和固定的档案管理并不能消除这种递归依赖. 即时突变提示并应用于任务即时突变[5];被检查的方法使用明显的更高级的即时突变提示来进行即时演化,因此其水平不应被倒塌为不受限制地再演化.

blocks.en: Gödel machines take a different route: self-modification is justified by proofs of utility under a formalized system [ 14 ] . Equation 18 is an empirical finite-audit condition with stated statistical assumptions, not a replacement for such a proof system or a universal self-improvement theorem. The practical comparison is between the objects that can change, the evidence that admits a change, and the role the changed object plays in the next improvement.
blocks.zh: Gödel机器走不同的路线:在正规化系统下,自我修饰以效用证明为理由[14]. 方程式18是一种经验性有限审计条件,有说明的统计假设,而不是取代这种证明系统或普遍的自改进定理. 实际比较是介于可以改变的对象,接受改变的证据,以及被改变的对象在接下来的改进中扮演的角色.

blocks.en: 9  Implementation, Cost, and Reproducibility
blocks.zh: 9 执行、费用和可复制性

blocks.en: 9.1  A version is a complete computational identity
blocks.zh: 9.1 国家 一个版本是一个完整的计算身份

blocks.en: A reproducible learner binds the substrate revision, shared offline adaptation, slow factors, updater implementation, tokenizer, numerical configuration, and task reader. Each study uses its own complete computational identity: the program study binds its SFT lineage and always-enabled offline component, while the SQL studies bind their task adapters. Loading verifies the original assets against that identity; detailed version relationships remain in the accompanying lineage records.

blocks.en: 10  Discussion
blocks.zh: 10 讨论情况

blocks.en: MMLA-RSI develops two ways for an adaptation method to participate in producing its successor. RTT changes the policy state through numerical learning. RTMA changes the authoritative evidence available to the next attempt. Their recursive layers change the numerical updater and memory manager, respectively, then return the admitted rule to that same role in the next generation. The joint construction retains both state paths instead of treating memory as an accessory to policy learning.
blocks.zh: MMLA-RSI为一种适应方法开发出两种方式,以参与生成其后继方法. RTT通过数字学习来改变策略状态. RTMA修改了下次尝试可用的权威证据. 他们的递归层分别更改了数字更新器和内存管理器,然后在下一代中将被接受的规则还原为同一角色. 联合建设保留了两种状态路径,而不是将内存视为政策学习的从犯.

blocks.en: The component evidence identifies practical difficulties: feedback can change behavior without improving it, a strong direct rule can outperform a learned carrier, and offline training can explain most gains attributed to an online system. These observations motivate measurements of complete task performance, state use, and discovery cost. They neither provide nor rule out an effective recursive chain in the proposed domains.
blocks.zh: 组成部分证据查明了实际困难:反馈可以改变行为而不加以改进,强而直接的规则可以超越有学问的载体,而离线训练可以解释归属于在线系统的大部分收益. 这些观测促使对全部任务性能、状态使用和发现成本进行测量。 它们既不提供也不排除拟议领域有效的递归链。

blocks.en: The minimal languages make limited parts of the adaptation process mutable. RTT varies scalar schedules within a fixed numerical template. RTMA varies which complete evidence rows are retained, including the option to write nothing. The trusted memory authority, record semantics, and evaluators stay fixed. More expressive memory transformations or numerical optimizers would be separate domains with their own bounds and comparisons.
blocks.zh: 最小语言使适应过程的有限部分变得可变. RTT在一个固定的数值模板中会改变分级表. RTMA保留了哪些完整的证据行,包括不写字的选择. 所信任的内存权威,记录语义,评价人员保持不变. 更多的表达式内存转换或数字优化器将与其自己的界限和比较分开。

blocks.en: The empirical question is whether a rule admitted for improved task behavior then helps produce another admitted rule, and whether that discovery process is useful relative to fixed rules and external search at the same information and total cost. Either route can be evaluated first. A joint claim additionally measures the complete task and both state paths, including the cost of invalidating or recomputing memory values when the reader changes.
blocks.zh: 经验问题在于,接受改进任务行为的规则是否有助于产生另一个被接受的规则,而这种发现过程相对于固定规则和以相同信息和总成本进行外部搜索是否有用。 两条路线都可以先评价. 一项联合索赔还测量了完整的任务和两种状态路径,包括当读者改变时无效或重算内存值的成本.

blocks.en: B.1  Program selection: useful adaptation with a stronger direct rule

blocks.en: The program task presents four complete candidate programs and supplies their execution feedback on support examples. The learner selects a program; it does not freely generate one. Both training objectives use the same input LARC4 position on the bound MiniCPM5-1B-SFT substrate with the shared offline component enabled. Two support-gradient steps use SGD with step size 0.1 0.1 , no momentum, no weight decay, and no inner clipping. The numerical query predicts a distribution over the four candidates, and expected execution error is the primary endpoint.

blocks.en: B.3  SQL interaction: state changes without endpoint gains
blocks.zh: B.3 SQL互动:状态变化而无终点收益

blocks.en: The first completed task-level SQL study uses grouped interactions from SParC [ 23 ] , with 56 development interactions across 28 databases and 75 confirmation interactions across 19 databases. Its primary endpoint is whole-interaction success: every turn must produce a query execution agreeing with the reference on the fixed database. This is an operational reference-concordance score, rather than a proof that two SQL programs are equivalent on all databases. Seeds are averaged within the interaction and then databases are weighted equally.
blocks.zh: 第一次完成的任务层次SQL研究利用了SParC[23]的分组互动,在28个数据库中有56个发展互动,在19个数据库中有75个确认互动。 其主要终点是整体互动成功:每一回合都必须产生一个查询执行,与固定数据库的参考一致。 这是一个可操作的参考-协和分数,而不是证明两个SQL程序在所有数据库中都是等同的. 种子在相互作用中平均,然后数据库平均加权。

blocks.en: The adapted real-feedback method reaches 18.42% confirmation success, compared with 20.18% for the static six-proposal frozen method. The paired difference is − 1.75 -1.75 percentage points, with a 97.5% database-bootstrap interval of [ − 4.39 , 0.88 ] [-4.39,0.88] . The three registered non-neural rule methods each score zero on this confirmation population; the development-selected rule remains the comparator. Beating those particular rules does not establish an advantage over general-purpose SQL systems.
blocks.zh: 调整后的实际反馈方法取得了18.42%的确认成功,而静态六提案冻结方法的确认成功率为20.18%。 成对相差为-1.75-1.75个百分点,数据库-波纹间隔为-9.5% [- 4.39, 0.88] [-4.39, 0.88]. 三种注册的非神经规则方法各在这一确认人口数上得分为零;发展选定的规则仍然是比较国。 凌驾于这些特定规则之上并不能确立相对于通用SQL系统的优势.

blocks.en: The saved-state audit is informative even though the main comparison fails. Across development and confirmation, 393 paired cases contain 1,965 fast-state packages. The audit verifies nonnull gradients and state changes in 786 keep packages and exact initialization, optimizer, and random-state restoration in 786 reset packages. On 225 confirmation task–seed pairs, real keep versus reset changes 14 third-proposal token sequences and three selected SQL outputs, while whole-interaction and last-turn scores remain unchanged in every paired case. Real versus sham produces different actual rewards and fast states in only six of these 225 pairs. This is evidence of local saved-output sensitivity and weak effective sham separation, not positive task benefit.
blocks.zh: 尽管主要比较失败,但保存状态审计还是提供了信息。 在整个开发和确认过程中,393个配对病例包含1,965个快状态包. 审计验证了786中的非null梯度和状态变化,保留了包并精确地初始化,优化器,786个重置包中的随机状态还原. 在225项确认任务上 - 种子对等,真实保持与重置变化 14 第3个提议令牌序列和3个选定的 SQL 输出,而整个交互和上个回合的分数在每个对等的情况下保持不变. 真实对假产生不同 实际奖励和快状态 在这225对中只有6对。 这表明当地节省产出的敏感性和薄弱的有效虚假分离,而不是积极的任务效益。

blocks.en: The offline SQL adaptation includes a rank-16 task adapter and the rank-4 input residual, totaling 700,416 trainable entries. Gains over the original model cannot be attributed to the fast residual alone. The strict saved-prefix retention and binding contrasts are zero at the task endpoints despite the verified state and output changes.
blocks.zh: 离线SQL改造包括一个16级任务适配器和4级输入剩余,共700,416个可训练条目. 相对于原始模型的收益不能仅仅归因于快速剩余。 严格保存的前缀保留和绑定对比值在任务终点为零,尽管经过核实的状态和输出有变化.

blocks.en: B.4  CoSQL correction transfer: online increment below the prespecified requirements
blocks.zh: B.4. COSQL更正转移:在线递增低于预先规定的要求

blocks.en: The next completed study uses CoSQL [ 22 ] under its own fixed correction-transfer protocol. The evaluation has 358 development episodes across 28 databases and 210 confirmation episodes across 19 databases, with three paired seeds and 43 method–seed cells over 568 episodes. All 24,424 logical records are complete. The endpoint is final-query execution concordance with the reference, macro-averaged by database. It is distinct from the previous study’s whole-interaction success and is not presented as an official benchmark leaderboard score.
blocks.zh: 下一份完成的研究在自己的固定修正-转移协议下使用COSQL [22]. 评估共有28个数据库的358个开发事件,19个数据库的210个确认事件,有3个对子种子和43个方法-种子细胞超过568个事件。 24,424个逻辑记录全部完成. 端点是最终-query执行与参考一致,由数据库进行宏观平均. 它与前一次研究的整个互动成功不同,没有作为正式的基准领导板得分。

blocks.en: The adapted real-feedback procedure differs from the static frozen comparator by − 0.979 -0.979 percentage points, with a 97.5% interval of [ − 4.247 , 1.759 ] [-4.247,1.759] . The registered task-level gate requires at least five points and a positive 97.5% lower bound against both the frozen method and the development-selected rule. It fails against the frozen method.

The strict checks use the stored unrounded bounds; the adapted-retention lower bound is exactly zero in the saved aggregate. These paired prefix reads differ from the complete procedures in Table 8 .

blocks.en: The final audit checks 13,632 prefix bindings and 3,408 reset/query-closure cases. Memory is disabled, but shared support text, proposal history, feedback, tools, and selectors remain in the declared read. The results therefore concern the additional numerical effect conditional on those channels. The substantial improvement over the original frozen substrate demonstrates a better task model. The prespecified deployment requirements—the task endpoint and the online Φ \Phi requirements—remain unmet for this numerical recipe; the completed models and failed comparisons are retained.
blocks.zh: 最后审计检查了13 632个前缀装订和3 408个重置/清仓结案。 内存被禁用,但共享支持文本,提案历史,反馈,工具,以及选择者仍保留在已声明读取中. 因此,结果涉及这些渠道的额外数字效应。 与原先被冻结的基底相比,有了实质性的改进,显示出更好的任务模式。 预先指定的部署要求——任务终点和在线的\\\\Phi要求——对于这个数字配方仍然未得到满足;完成的模型和失败的比较被保留.

blocks.en: The recursive design must use the same discipline. A fast updater can be expensive to discover; a model that improves after more attempts may lose under an equal complete-task budget.
